steps.name: Open builder with no items
steps.do: Start the wizard and advance through steps without selecting animals/attractions/talks/encounters/transport.
steps.expect: Wizard allows advancing with empty selections.

steps.name: Finish empty
steps.expect: **No Items Selected** (or equivalent) blocks a successful empty itinerary.

steps.name: Acknowledge empty state
steps.expect: Back in builder; can still edit.

steps.name: Clear itinerary
steps.expect: **Clear Itinerary?** confirmation appears with the remove-all message.
